# Script Gods Must Die

> > A comprehensive screenwriting resource offering consulting services, educational courses, and practical advice for aspiring and professional screenwriters.

Script Gods Must Die is run by Paul Peditto, an experienced screenwriter and consultant based in Chicago. The site combines professional screenplay consulting services with a robust blog covering screenwriting fundamentals, industry insights, and practical tips for writers navigating the film and television landscape.

## Key Topics

- screenwriting
- screenplay consulting
- Paul Peditto
- script analysis
- story structure
- creative control
- copyright ownership

- screenwriting services

- screenwriter tips
- playwright transition
- screenwriting advice

- [Screenplay Consulting Services](https://www.scriptgodsmustdie.com/screenwriting-services): Screenplay consulting and script analysis services by Paul Peditto.

- [Screenwriting Series](https://www.scriptgodsmustdie.com/estore-action): Online screenwriting courses and webinars by Paul Peditto.

## Screenwriting Craft & Technique

- [Notes From Friends & Family](https://www.scriptgodsmustdie.com/2025/06/notes-from-friends-family): Article on receiving screenplay feedback and constructive criticism.
- [He Who Calls The Tune…](https://www.scriptgodsmustdie.com/2026/01/he-who-calls-the-tune): Article on creative control and copyright ownership in screenwriting.
- [A Screenwriter's Island Life Initialization](https://www.scriptgodsmustdie.com/2025/09/a-screenwriters-island-life-initialization): Perspective on AI tools and screenwriting collaboration.
- [Verticals, Part 2: Shooting Them](https://www.scriptgodsmustdie.com/2025/10/verticals-part-2-shooting-them): Guide to shooting vertical video for mobile platforms.
